title: The village clinic
paragraphs: The village clinic was usually {{1}} on Mondays, with only two or three patients, but this week the waiting room was full. A fever had {{2}} through the nearby houses. Dr Sinta asked Yusuf, a student volunteer, to write down each patient’s name and {{3}} their temperature.
By noon, the line had grown {{4}}, and some people were becoming {{5}}. Yusuf brought them water and explained the delay. He felt {{6}} of his small job, because it let the doctor work faster.
